title: Behold the Wood (Good Friday)
content:
Song von: Dan Schutte

Behold, behold the wood of the cross
On which is hung our salvation
O come, let us adore

1.
Unless, a grain of wheat shall fall upon the ground and die
It shall remain, but a single grain and not give life

Ref.:
Behold, behold the wood of the cross
On which is hung our salvation
O come, let us adore

2.
And when My hour of glory comes
As all was meant to be
You shall see Me lifted up upon a tree

Behold, behold the wood of the cross
On which is hung our salvation
O come, let us adore

3.
For there can be no greater love shown upon this land
than in the ONE who came to die that we may live

Behold, behold the wood of the cross
On which is hung our salvation
O come, let us adore
